description_en: Queries the details about data transfer plans of simple application servers
description_zh: 查询一个或多个实例的流量包详情信息
name: ListInstancesTrafficPackages

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the simple application servers. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.help_zh: 地域ID。您可以调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/189315.html查询可用地域
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The IDs of the simple application servers. The value can be a JSON array that consists of up to 100 simple application server IDs. Separate multiple server IDs with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 轻量应用服务器实例ID。取值可以由一个或多个实例ID组成一个JSON数组，最多支持100个实例ID，实例ID之间用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: instance_ids

InstanceTrafficPackageUsages.description_en: The data transfers that exceed the quota of the data transfer plan in the current month. Unit: bytes

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the simple application server

TrafficOverflow.description_en: The data transfers that exceeds the quota of the data transfer plan in the current month. Unit: Byte
TrafficOverflow.description_zh: 流量包当月周期内超出流量包额度的流量。单位：Byte

TrafficPackageRemaining.description_en: The unused quota of the data transfer plan in the current month. Unit: Byte
TrafficPackageRemaining.description_zh: 流量包当月周期内的剩余流量。单位：Byte

TrafficPackageTotal.description_en:
The quota of the data transfer plan in the current month. Unit: Byte.

TrafficPackageTotal = TrafficUsed + TrafficPackageRemaining
TrafficPackageTotal.description_zh:
流量包当月周期内的总流量。单位：Byte。

流量包当月周期内的总流量=流量包当月周期内已使用流量+流量包当月周期内的剩余流量

TrafficUsed.description_en: The used quota of the data transfer plan in the current month. Unit: Byte
TrafficUsed.description_zh: 流量包当月周期内已使用流量。单位：Byte
